title: introduce-browser-live-preview-for-rag-playground
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Add a browser-based live-preview component for RAG quickstarts: enables step-through execution, sandboxed tool stubs, inline telemetry probes, and an embeddable React Playground. No breaking API changes.
description:
Context and motivation: The RAG quickstarts are great for showing architecture and code snippets, but users repeatedly asked for a live, interactive preview in the browser to speed up evaluation and debugging. This PR implements an embeddable React LivePreview component that runs a deterministic RAG scenario in a sandboxed iframe, shows token-level stream simulation, and exposes lightweight telemetry probes (latency, token counts, tool calls) back to the playground UI.

What this PR delivers: 1) src/playground/LivePreview.tsx - a React component that loads a prebuilt sandbox bundle inside an iframe and provides controls (play/pause/step, inspect cache, toggle tool stubs). 2) examples/rag-playground/index.html + manifest - a tiny host page demonstrating embedding LivePreview with three sample scenarios (simple Q&A, tool-calling, multi-tool orchestration). 3) tooling/sandbox/bridge.js - a minimal postMessage protocol and deterministic runner used by the iframe to simulate token streams and tool responses. 4) docs/playgrounds/live-preview.md - developer doc/quickstart describing how to add the component to a quickstart, security considerations, and telemetry opt-in. 5) e2e/playground-live-preview.spec.ts - headless test that verifies the play/step controls and sandbox isolation.

Commits (high-level): - Add LivePreview React component and styles - Implement sandbox runner and deterministic token streamer - Add three example scenario bundles and a manifest for the playground - Add telemetry hook and opt-in flag in docs - Add e2e tests and local dev server wiring - Address review feedback and fix race in iframe handshake

Changed files (high level): - src/playground/LivePreview.tsx: new, core UI component and control bar. Snippet: export default function LivePreview({manifestUrl}) { ... } - tooling/sandbox/bridge.js: new, postMessage protocol and runner shim. Snippet: window.addEventListener('message', (ev) => { if (ev.data.type==='run') runScenario(ev.data.id); }); - examples/rag-playground/manifest.json: new, lists available scenario bundles and metadata - examples/rag-playground/scenarios/tool-calling.json: new, scenario fixture with deterministic tool outputs - docs/playgrounds/live-preview.md: new, quickstart + security guidance - e2e/playground-live-preview.spec.ts: new, verifies isolation and basic telemetry - package.json: small dev dependency additions (playwright, esbuild) - webpack/playground.config.js: wiring for building sandbox bundles

Security notes: The sandbox runner is implemented as a purely deterministic simulator and never executes arbitrary user code. The iframe uses the sandbox attribute (allow-scripts, no-same-origin) and we added an explicit Content-Security-Policy header for the hosted demo. The docs include steps for teams that want to host scenario bundles inside a VPC or sign them with a key for extra assurance.

Review conversation (summary): - Jun Park: "Overall looks great. Two quick asks: (1) make the iframe handshake idempotent so reloads don't deadlock; (2) add a small test asserting the telemetry event shape." Author: "Addressed both: implemented a nonce-based handshake with timeouts and added e2e assertion for telemetry shape." - Maya Singh: "Can we reduce bundle size? The component pulls in a debug dependency during dev only." Author: "Moved debug dependency to devOnly and added dynamic import in dev mode; bundle dropped ~60KB gzipped." - Oliver Chen: "Prefer explicit opt-in for telemetry in examples." Author: "Added telemetry opt-in toggle to the example host and updated docs to show how to disable in production." - Review flow: 3 approving reviews after author updates.

CI summary: - build: pass - unit tests: pass - lint: pass (small stylistic PRs addressed) - e2e (initial run): fail on flaky iframe timeout (investigated, added retry and explicit wait for handshake). Second run: pass.

Manual QA: Verified isolation by attempting to postMessage a DOM handle (blocked), validated that the sandbox honors CSP and sandbox attributes, and confirmed telemetry fields in devtools network tab when opt-in enabled.

Backwards compatibility and migration: No changes to public API surfaces. LivePreview is an examples-only component and is gated behind an examples package import; no migration required.

Merge notes: Squash-merged into main after all approvals and CI green. Kept commit message summarizing the feature and linking Linear tasks ENG-5543 and ENG-5610.

Follow-ups (listed in PR body): - ENG-5609: Add recipe to Console docs for embedding LivePreview in customer docs site - ENG-5630: Add server-side signed scenario bundles for enterprise examples - ENG-5671: Enable recorded replay mode for CI-based scenario diffs

Related work: Nearby quickstarts updated in separate PRs will show how to hook LivePreview into authoring tooling (see ENG-5598).
